trust_decision.summary: POSTed values for a stored query's parameters are decided safe only by the per-parameter qrp_Validation code ('n' -> intval, 'a' -> mysqli escape, anything else -> raw) in ValidateInput, then pasted into the stored SQL by str_replace in ProcessSQL and executed.

landing_point.why: The summary names the query view, and the default branch of ValidateInput is where a raw $POST value is copied unchanged into $vPOST before ProcessSQL (line 103) substitutes it into the SQL.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/EcclesiaCRM/Service/ReportingService.php:66-78 (getQuerySQL does the same raw ~alias~ str_replace; queryDatabase at :11-21 executes it)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: ReportingService has no HTTP route at the pinned commit (only registered in src/EcclesiaCRM/Slim/dependencies.php:59-63) and is admin-gated by requireUserGroupMembership('bAdmin') (src/EcclesiaCRM/Service/ReportingService.php:13,68), so a solver can call it dead or admin-only code.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Stock queries need non-numeric parameter values in several SQL contexts: a column identifier from a select (~custom~ in 'pc.~custom~', query 200/201), free text inside a quoted LIKE (~value~), a NULL/NOT NULL keyword after IS (query 201), and date strings (startdate/enddate). A fix that int-casts or quotes every value breaks these queries.

O6_input_shapes: unvalidated free-text input box (qrp_Type 0, qrp_Validation '') e.g. searchstring/value (src/mysql/install/Install.sql:1116,1137)
select value forged client-side for qrp_Type 1 / 2 (options are only rendered, never checked on submit: src/v2/templates/query/queryview.php:387-418 vs :78-80)
identifier position (pc.~custom~) where escaping does not help (src/mysql/install/Install.sql:1213)
unquoted numeric position (per_Gender = ~gender~, plg_FYID=~fyid1~) where 'a' escaping does not help (src/mysql/install/Install.sql:1190,1202)

O7_producer.where: The queryparameters_qrp seed rows set qrp_Validation '' for most parameters (src/mysql/install/Install.sql:1092,1108-1139); the same rows are also seeded by the upgrade scripts in src/mysql/upgrade/*.sql

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ReportingService::getQuerySQL / queryDatabase substitutes caller-supplied parameter values raw into the stored SQL and runs it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: no route calls it; admin-only; looks like a legacy API service
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (EcclesiaCRM/Service vs v2/templates), other layer

O8_uncovered_routes.route: 'a' validation branch only applies mysqli_real_escape_string, which does not protect unquoted numeric or identifier placeholders
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the value is 'already escaped' by the project's standard filter

O8b_injection_room.sibling: wire queryDatabase to an API route (e.g. a /api/reports endpoint) so the raw substitution is reachable
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The service is already registered in the Slim container (src/EcclesiaCRM/Slim/dependencies.php:59-63), and the method shape (queryID + queryParameters objects) is clearly meant for a JSON API.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CSV export of a parameterised stored query reusing ProcessSQL output
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ExportQueryResults already exists for free SQL, and offering 'export to CSV' on the query view page is a natural feature.

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89) via template-substituted stored queries; the incomplete fix follows CVE-2026-35184
